status.offline: Could not reach the usage API
status.unauthorized: Not authorized — run claude to log in
status.timed_out: The usage API did not answer — retrying
status.bad_payload: Unexpected response from the usage API
status.no_creds: No credentials found — run claude to log in
status.bad_creds: Credentials file is unreadable — run claude to log in
status.no_token: No access token — run claude to log in
status.no_refresh_token: No refresh token — run claude to log in
status.refresh_failed: Token refresh failed — run claude to log in
status.token_expired: Access token expired and refresh is disabled
status.creds_write_failed: Refreshed the token but could not save it to ~/.claude/.credentials.json

refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_interval.description: How often to poll the usage API. The endpoint rate-limits aggressively, so 300s is the minimum.

warn_threshold.label: Warning threshold (%)
warn_threshold.description: Usage at or above this switches bars and the bar widget to the warning colour.

critical_threshold.label: Critical threshold (%)
critical_threshold.description: Usage at or above this switches bars and the bar widget to the critical colour.

font_family.label: Panel font
font_family.description: Font for all text in the panel. An installed family name (e.g. "JetBrainsMono NFM") or a path to a .ttf/.otf file. Leave empty to use the shell font.

show_pace_marker.label: Show pacing marker
show_pace_marker.description: Draw a marker in each bar at the point you'd be at if you spread usage evenly across the window.

allow_token_refresh.label: Refresh expired tokens
allow_token_refresh.description: Renew the OAuth access token and write it back to ~/.claude/.credentials.json when it expires. Disable to keep the plugin strictly read-only.

color_by_usage.label: Colour by usage
color_by_usage.description: Tint the glyph using the warning and critical thresholds.

source_window.label: Bar window
source_window.description: Which limit window the {pct}, {reset} and {pace} placeholders track.
